items.title: Working with @AMD, our models identified up to 14% PPA improvement on flagship GPU IP in less than five months—building on designs AMD’s engineers had already spent years optimizing. The same approach helped improve Jalapeño, our first custom inference chip, with gains verified on real silicon. New evaluations also show our models getting better at certain chip design tasks. We’re sharing these results and how we’re working with @Synopsys to bring our model capabilities and their trusted EDA design and validation tools to more chip designers.
